input: Set up a monthly automatic donation to charity

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: Whether they have a specific charity in mind or need help choosing one entirely changes the first steps of the plan.
The monthly donation amount determines which platforms are viable and shapes the overall financial commitment.
Whether this is a personal donation or on behalf of a business or family affects tax treatment, account setup, and receipt requirements.
The preferred payment method (credit card, bank transfer, PayPal, etc.) determines which donation platforms or charity portals are compatible.
The user's country affects which platforms are available, what tax-deductibility rules apply, and how to find registered charities.
Knowing whether getting a tax receipt matters to the user decides whether they must use a registered charitable platform vs. a simpler direct method.
Whether they want to donate to one specific cause or spread giving across multiple charities shapes how many accounts or platforms need to be set up.

gold.taskTitle: Set up a monthly automatic charity donation
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to configure a recurring monthly donation to one or more charities, automatically charged on a schedule.

questions.title: Do you already have a specific charity picked out?
questions.description: Determines whether the plan starts with charity discovery/research or jumps straight to setting up a donation account.

questions.title: How much do you want to donate each month?
questions.description: The intended monthly amount affects which platforms are suitable and confirms the financial commitment involved.

questions.title: Is this donation personal or on behalf of a business?
questions.description: Personal vs. business giving affects tax treatment, the type of receipt needed, and whose account the donation comes from.

questions.title: Which payment method do you prefer to use?
questions.description: Credit card, bank transfer, PayPal, or another method determines which charity portals or giving platforms are compatible.

questions.title: Which country are you donating from?
questions.description: Country determines platform availability, local registered charities, and applicable tax-deductibility rules.

questions.title: Does receiving a tax-deductible receipt matter to you?
questions.description: If tax receipts are important, the charity and platform must be officially registered, which narrows the options significantly.

questions.title: Do you want to give to one charity or several?
questions.description: Donating to a single charity vs. splitting across multiple causes affects how many accounts or platforms need to be configured.
